scripts.dev: concurrently -k --names "BACKEND,FRONTEND" --prefix-colors "magenta.bold,cyan.bold" --prefix "[{time}] [{name}]" --timestamp-format "HH:mm:ss" "npm run dev --prefix backend" "npm run dev --prefix frontend"

scripts.vercel-build: npm run db:generate --prefix backend && npm run build --prefix frontend
